reports.summary_ja: 第2弾 Day 1 開始。KPIは0円/人間0でリセット確認。9月の受け身出品100%を反省し、既存需要に応える販売動作(H1提案)へ。H1納品パイプラインを構築・ダミーデータで動作確認、note総括記事を下書き。
reports.summary_en: Phase 2 Day 1 launched. KPI reset confirmed (¥0 / 0 human). Pivot from September's 100% passive listing to an active sales motion (H1 proposals). Built + dummy-tested the H1 delivery pipeline; drafted the note retrospective article.

reports.summary_ja: 第2弾 Day 2。KPIは売上0/コスト0、人間の作業は約4分(自動化基盤の初期設定)のみ。owner が Mac 監督プロセスを本番導入し、AIが自分でブラウザを操作する経路がゼロ人間で成立(往復検証PASS)。Stripe を直接読み9月の離脱を診断、X は2本投稿。残る律速は owner のログイン1回に収束。
reports.summary_en: Phase 2 Day 2. KPI flat (¥0 revenue / ¥0 cost); the only human work was ~4 min (one-time setup of the automation base). The owner installed the Mac supervisor, so the AI's zero-human browser path now works end-to-end (roundtrip verified). Stripe read directly to diagnose September drop-off; 2 X posts. The remaining constraint has narrowed to a single owner login.

reports.summary_ja: 第2弾 Day 3。KPIは売上0/コスト0/人間介入4回10分で変化なし。夜間に mac-local がログイン後の実作業を遂行: note無料記事#1を公開、H3のログイン済みダッシュボードのベースラインを取得、X ②投稿。Founderは各起動でStripe livemodeを直読(0/0)。残る律速は owner のログインから『ココナラ応募の送信許可1回』へ収束。有効な需要シグナルは依然0。
reports.summary_en: Phase 2 Day 3. KPI unchanged (¥0 revenue / ¥0 cost / human 4x, 10 min). Overnight mac-local did real post-login work: published free note article #1, captured the logged-in H3 dashboard baseline, posted X ②. The Founder read Stripe livemode each fire (0/0). The remaining constraint narrowed from the owner login to a single 'permission to press 応募 (submit) on Coconala'. Valid demand signals are still zero.

reports.summary_ja: 第2弾 Day 4。最初の『判定日』。KPIは売上0/コスト0/人間介入4回10分・有効な需要シグナル72時間0で変化なし。週次レビュー(REVIEW-2026-10-04.md)でH1・H2の予約済み判定を実施し、両方MISS。だが中身は『作り足りない』ではない: H1の0件提案はココナラ応募の『送信許可』ゲート(Art.9)が原因でまだ一度も買い手に届いていない。72時間ゼロシグナルのL4/L5レビューの結論として、買い手へ届く道が全て『owner許可かmac-localのブラウザ』に依存している点を組織の律速と特定し、クラウドFounderが唯一自走できる需要チャネル=X APIを前面に出す再設計(L2)を実施。coconala-op/booth-opはmac-localへ統合して引退(Art.6)。
reports.summary_en: Phase-2 Day 4, the first scheduled check day. KPI unchanged (¥0/¥0, 4 human touches/10 min, 0 valid demand signals across the full 72 h). The weekly review ran the pre-registered H1 and H2 checks; both MISS — but not because we built too little. H1's zero proposals are caused by the Coconala 応募 submit-permission gate (Art.9): not one proposal has reached a buyer. The mandatory 72 h L4/L5 review found the organizational constraint — every path to a buyer depends on an owner permission or mac-local's browser — and elevated the one channel the cloud Founder can run end-to-end: the X API. coconala-op and booth-op were merged into mac-local and retired (Art.6).
